Construct metadata for a neurogam result

Source: R/neurogam_metadata.R
make_neurogam_metadata.Rd

Records the analysis specification that is known when a result is created. This function does not infer settings from a fitted model or posterior summaries. A `NULL` field represents a setting not recorded for that result.

Usage

make_neurogam_metadata(
  analysis_type,
  time_id,
  space_id = NULL,
  sensor_id = NULL,
  participant_id = NULL,
  outcome_id = NULL,
  predictor_id = NULL,
  multilevel = NULL,
  threshold = NULL,
  threshold_type = NULL,
  null_value = NULL,
  rope = NULL,
  baseline_window = NULL,
  credible_interval = NULL,
  odds_mode = NULL,
  contrast = NULL,
  contrast_levels = NULL,
  adjacency_source = NULL,
  participant_clusters = NULL,
  n_post_samples = NULL
)

Arguments

analysis_type

One of `"temporal"`, `"temporal_generalization"`, or `"spatiotemporal"`.

time_id

Names of time coordinates in the resulting predictions.

space_id

Names of projected spatial coordinates, for spatiotemporal results only.

sensor_id

Name of the sensor identifier column, for spatiotemporal results only.

participant_id, outcome_id, predictor_id

Original input column names.

multilevel

Model aggregation mode.

threshold, threshold_type

Threshold used for cluster detection.

null_value

Null reference for the effect or contrast.

rope

Fixed ROPE half-width, when one was specified.

baseline_window

Baseline interval defining a data-dependent ROPE, when applicable. The resulting numerical ROPE width is not stored here.

credible_interval

Credible interval width.

odds_mode

Posterior-odds strategy actually used by the analysis.

contrast

Description of the estimated effect or difference.

contrast_levels

Explicit condition labels, when available.

adjacency_source

One of `"auto_knn"`, `"provided"`, or `NULL`.

participant_clusters

Whether participant-level clusters were computed.

n_post_samples

Number of posterior draws requested or used.

Value

A named metadata list.
